g.text: Each read goes to its best match
assigned to the target (every second drawn)
Every read is aligned to the target, its paralogue and any contaminant at once,
and goes to whichever it matches best: reads below the diagonal are closer to
the target. A paralogue can also be analysed as a target of its own.
